name: Hinge
description: Two leaves meeting exactly at the fold, so the join reads as a single figure.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); -webkit-clip-path: polygon(100% 8%, 100% 92%, 20% 50%); clip-path: polygon(100% 8%, 100% 92%, 20% 50%); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } @match(@x > @X / 2) { -webkit-transform: scaleX(-1); transform: scaleX(-1); } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
